submitted.rationale: EQE falls as Sb increases: 0.0847% at Sb=0.167 (idx 2), 0.0827% at 0.231 (idx 5), 0.0625% at 0.331 (idx 9), 0.031% at 0.519 (idx 15), 0.032% at 0.748 (idx 24). XRD at Sb 0.14, 0.23 and 0.36 shows a single rutile-type phase with no hematite peaks. Idx 1 also has one weak extra reflection at Q≈0.86 that I did not identify. The response is flat between Sb 0.17 and 0.23, so the peak is at Fe-rich compositions. Idx 2 had the highest EQE I measured.
